facts.claim: Colombo Consumer Price Index inflation reached 69.8% year on year in September 2022
facts.note: The national index (NCPI) was higher, 73.7% in the same month. The video shows the Colombo figure and labels it as such.

facts.claim: Protesters entered the President's official residence on 9 July 2022
Gotabaya Rajapaksa flew to the Maldives on 13 July 2022, on to Singapore on 14 July, and sent his resignation that day
facts.note: The resignation was formally accepted on 15 July; the stamp shows 14 July, the day it was submitted.

facts.claim: Sheikh Hasina resigned and left Bangladesh for India on 5 August 2024
Nepal's PM K.P. Sharma Oli resigned on 9 September 2025 after Gen Z protests that began over a social-media ban

facts.claim: Cockroach Janta Party was founded on 16 May 2026 by Abhijeet Dipke

facts.note: CNN reported the Prime Minister had not yet publicly accepted it; the on-screen stamp says 'announced'.

facts.claim: CJP is protesting over the Election Commission's SIR voter-roll revision and demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation
Narration: 'According to Reuters', Dipke leads a national campaign on voter roll revision
facts.status: fact supported by CNN and Al Jazeera; the Reuters attribution was NOT found

facts.claim: Dhruv Rathee was announced as special guest at a CJP protest
Dipke previously worked with the Aam Aadmi Party and acknowledged it in an interview with The Wire
Narration: ThePrint examined a 12-member CJP team and reported six had past AAP association or publicly supported AAP
facts.status: NOT verified: the article and the 12/6 figures were not found. On screen the video only says several members' AAP links have been questioned, which other outlets report

facts.claim: Narration: 'According to The Indian Express', CJP researcher Vijeta Dahiya was introduced to the team through Dhruv Rathee
facts.status: fact supported by Brut India (joined on Rathee's advice); the Indian Express attribution was NOT found. Reports call him a spokesperson, and suggest he may no longer hold the role

facts.status: not checked; the year is not shown on screen
